# Synthetic audio fixtures

Generated signals with no recorded or user content:

- `01.flac`, `02.mp3` — 12 s chord, 44.1 kHz stereo (FLAC and 128 kbit/s MP3).
- `prefix-125s.flac` — 125 s 440 Hz sine, 8 kHz mono, for prefix-window decoding.

They exercise decoding and fingerprinting, not real AcoustID recognition.
